Proprietary Software Ecosystem:
- XenoCRM (https://xenotrix.in/products/xenocrm): Multi-tenant SaaS Business OS uniting CRM, billing, and WhatsApp.
- XenoFin (https://xenotrix.in/products/xenofin): Financial intelligence, ledger reconciliation, GST/tax calculation.
- XenoBiz (https://xenotrix.in/products/xenobiz): Mobile-first billing, customer ledgers, and WhatsApp commerce for SMBs and retail.
- XenoClass (https://xenotrix.in/products/xenoclass): Learning Management System (LMS) with WebRTC virtual classrooms.
- XenoHR (https://xenotrix.in/products/xenohr): Automated payroll rule engine, biometric attendance, employee portal.
- Xenotune (https://xenotrix.in/products/xenotune): Procedural WebAudio ambient acoustic synthesizer for cognitive focus.
